subject: [PATCH v5 08/22] ntfs3: convert iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

2026-07-29.patch_summary: This patch converts the iomap operations for the ntfs3 file system to use the new ->iomap_next() callback, which is generated by a macro that wraps the iomap_iter_next helper. This change does not introduce any functional changes and simply updates the code to conform to the latest API requirements.
